title: Sample reset token never expires
description: An invented weakness in the sample service (critical).
root_cause: The handler in src/sample/api-critical-account-takeover.ts trusts a value the caller controls.
intended_behavior: The handler should check the value against the signed-in account before using it.

trace.description: The route reads the value from the request.
The value is stored without a check.

evidence.description: No ownership check precedes the call.

execution.attacker_perspective: A signed-in user of another account.
instructions: Send the payload to the route as the second user.
execution.observed_result: The service stored the record under the other account.

remediation.strategy: Compare the value with the session account and refuse a mismatch.

title: Sample upload may have no size limit
description: The upload route might accept very large files.
claimed_root_cause: The body parser limit is not set in src/web/upload.ts.

trace.description: The route streams the body to disk.

evidence.description: No limit option is passed to the parser.

blockers: The reverse proxy in front of the service may already cap the body size.

validation_plan.local: Post a 2 GB file to a local run.
validation_plan.deployment: Ask the owner what the proxy allows.

title: Sample comment field may allow script injection
description: The comment field is rendered on the page.
claimed_root_cause: The comment is written into the page unescaped.

evidence.description: The framework escapes the text before it is rendered.

reason: The framework escapes the value, and a local run showed the script as plain text.
